about_me.title: About me
about_me.subtitle: Mobile, front-end and interactive experience profile
about_me.first_para: I design and build mobile and web applications with a strong focus on interface quality, stability and long-term maintainability.
about_me.second_para: My background started with AI, image processing and computer vision, which gave me a solid technical foundation and a rigorous way of analysing problems.
about_me.third_para: Over the past few years, I have specialised in cross-platform development with Flutter, React Native and React, across products used in very different business contexts.
about_me.fourth_para: I enjoy turning a functional need into a clear experience: front-end architecture, reusable components, smooth navigation, responsive layouts and visual details that build confidence.
about_me.fifth_para: I am also progressively strengthening my backend skills with Node.js, APIs and data so I can deliver more complete, coherent and scalable solutions.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Technologies I use to deliver real products...
skills.content_bitbucket:
I have used Bitbucket in team environments to centralise code, manage branches and keep client projects organised.

For me, it is mostly tied to professional workflows where traceability, reviews and coordination between developers matter.
skills.content_c:
C is part of my engineering foundation. It taught me to reason closer to the machine, understand memory and write code with more precision.

Even if it is not my main language today, this background still helps me approach performance, system logic and algorithmic rigor.
skills.content_firebase:
Firebase has helped me prototype and build mobile features quickly: authentication, real-time databases, storage and first backend bricks.

I use it mainly when a product needs to move fast or when an idea needs to be validated before setting up a complete backend architecture.
skills.content_flutter:
Flutter is my main technology for building cross-platform mobile applications. I use it to create clean, performant and consistent interfaces on Android and iOS.

I have used Flutter on professional and personal applications, from scratch development to screen architecture, navigation, state management and API integration.
skills.content_github:
GitHub is my main environment for personal and open-source projects. I use it to version, document, track changes and keep a clear history of my work.

It also lets me show how I structure a project, evolve a codebase and keep a clean workflow.
skills.content_mysql:
MySQL is one of the SQL databases I can work with to model data, structure relationships and connect a mobile or web application to a reliable source.

I use it from a product perspective: understanding the required data, keeping the structure readable and making front-end/backend exchanges easier.
skills.content_nodejs:
Node.js allows me to extend my scope to backend work: APIs, business logic, services and database connections.

I see it as a natural complement to my mobile/front-end profile, helping me understand the whole product chain and deliver more autonomous features.
skills.content_postman:
Postman is part of my daily workflow whenever an application communicates with an API. I use it to understand contracts, test edge cases and secure front-end integration.

It helps me save time, isolate issues quickly and communicate more effectively with backend teams.
skills.content_python:
Python is the language that introduced me to development, especially through AI, machine learning, image processing and computer vision.

This experience gave me a useful technical culture for analysing problems, handling data and keeping a structured approach to complex topics.
skills.content_reactnative:
React Native has allowed me to work on existing mobile applications, especially in redesign and user experience improvement contexts.

I use it with a React-like mindset: clear components, controlled navigation and close attention to consistency between Android and iOS.
skills.content_reactjs:
React is the foundation I use to build modular, maintainable and scalable web interfaces. This portfolio is a concrete example with routing, i18n, CSS Modules and a 3D scene.

I value React because it makes interfaces easier to organise into readable components and lets an application evolve without losing consistency.
skills.content_reactredux:
Redux has mainly helped me on projects where application state had to remain predictable across screens, flows or navigation returns.

I do not use it by reflex: I choose it when synchronisation, persistence or state readability really justify that layer.
skills.content_sequelize:
Sequelize helps connect a Node.js backend to a SQL database more cleanly, with models, relations and a more structured query layer.

I see it as a useful piece for strengthening my fullstack profile, especially on projects where data must remain organised and maintainable.
skills.content_sourcetree:
SourceTree has been useful in team contexts to visualise branches, follow merges and understand a shared Git history more easily.

Even if I often work directly with Git or GitHub, I can use this kind of tool when the team or project context requires it.
skills.content_threejs:
Three.js lets me bring a more immersive dimension to a web interface, as shown in the 3D scene of this portfolio.

I use it carefully: the goal is not visual effect for its own sake, but a strong identity while keeping navigation clear and performant.
skills.content_kotlin:
Kotlin gives me a more direct understanding of the native Android ecosystem, which is useful for understanding what happens under cross-platform frameworks.

Even if my daily work is more focused on Flutter and React Native, this foundation helps me discuss mobile topics closer to the platform.

experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.subtitle: Professional path and key responsibilities
experiences.point_1_experience_1: Led front-end work and Flutter development for a mobile and web solution helping healthcare professionals donate vaccines, with a strong focus on reliable flows and usability. Reference: Sauve mon vaccin
experiences.point_2_experience_1: Redesigned a cruise booking application in React Native, integrating a client-imposed design and improving the readability of user journeys. Reference: Corsica Ferries
experiences.point_3_experience_1: Developed a Flutter application dedicated to sports tournament information, with a structure designed to handle varied and evolving data. Reference: Madewis
experiences.point_4_experience_1: Created a Flutter mobile social network around shared interests, focusing on onboarding, navigation and user interactions. Reference: Hobbies
experiences.point_5_experience_1: Designed a mobile attendance management tool for a training organisation, built to simplify field actions and reduce input errors. Reference: La croix rouge française
experiences.point_1_experience_2: Intensive self-taught mobile development journey, building skills in Flutter, Firebase and complete application design.
experiences.point_2_experience_2: Created a first product version from scratch, from idea to functional prototype, with testing, iteration and technical structuring in mind.
experiences.point_1_experience_3: Contributed to the company cybersecurity strategy through risk analysis, structured recommendations and synthesis work in an industrial context.
experiences.point_1_experience_4: Developed a Flutter mobile application for tracking a sports season, focusing on information clarity, stability and supporter experience. Reference: ASM Clermont Auvergne
experiences.point_1_experience_5: Developed a Flutter mobile application for local information, designed to make events and activities accessible through a simple, scalable experience. Reference: Paris ma Ville
experiences.point_1_experience_6: Led the front-end tech work for almost a year on a Flutter mobile application built from scratch for BC Hydro, a Canadian electricity company, coordinating a France-based front-end team with a Canada-based backend team. Reference: BC Hydro

projects.subtitle_pro: Professional references focused on product, mobile and delivery
projects.subtitle_private: Personal projects for experimenting, learning and structuring
projects.content_project_pro_1: Flutter mobile and web solution to streamline vaccine donations between healthcare professionals.
projects.content_project_pro_2: React Native redesign of a mobile booking flow with strong client design constraints.
projects.content_project_pro_3: Flutter application for sports tournament tracking and event information.
projects.content_project_pro_4: Flutter mobile social network built around interests and affinity-based connections.
projects.content_project_pro_5: Flutter attendance management application designed to simplify field training follow-up.
projects.content_project_pro_6: Flutter application dedicated to rugby season tracking and supporter engagement.
projects.content_project_pro_7: Flutter local information application centralising Paris events, activities and news.
projects.content_project_pro_8: Flutter mobile application built from scratch for a Canadian electricity company.
projects.content_project_perso_1: First personal Flutter mobile application around esport, community features and Firebase.
projects.content_project_perso_2: Flutter application base designed to speed up the start of future mobile projects.
projects.content_project_perso_3: React and Three.js portfolio designed to present my profile through an immersive visual identity.
projects.content_project_perso_4: Node.js Discord bot centralising game data and automating useful answers for a community.
projects.content_context_smv: The goal was to create a mobile and web solution that could facilitate vaccine exchanges between doctors, pharmacists and healthcare professionals. My work focused on building a clear, reliable product for a sensitive business context.
projects.challenges_content_smv: The main challenges were flow quality, consistency between mobile and web, information readability and product robustness around important user data.
projects.results_content_smv: The solution centralised exchanges, made key actions more accessible and established a technical foundation able to evolve with the service needs.
projects.content_context_cf: The project aimed to improve a React Native cruise booking mobile application in a context where brand identity and client constraints were already strong.
projects.challenges_content_cf: The challenge was to respect the imposed design while making the flows smoother, clearer and more pleasant to use on Android and iOS.
projects.results_content_cf: The redesign strengthened the visual consistency of the application and improved the booking flow perception through a cleaner, better-structured interface.
projects.content_context_madewis: This Flutter application had to let users easily consult information related to sports tournaments organised by the client.
projects.challenges_content_madewis: The interface had to support varied data formats while keeping navigation clear and the mobile experience consistent.
projects.results_content_madewis: The application provided centralised tournament information and a flexible mobile foundation for different kinds of sports events.
projects.content_context_hobbies: Hobbies aimed to connect users around shared interests through an accessible mobile social experience.
projects.challenges_content_hobbies: The main challenge was making onboarding, discovery and interactions simple enough to encourage usage while keeping the technical base scalable.
projects.results_content_hobbies: The project delivered a mobile application structuring profiles, interests and first interactions around a clear and engaging experience.
projects.content_context_crf: The project answered a training organisation need: quickly tracking attendance and absences during sessions directly from mobile.
projects.challenges_content_crf: The challenge was reducing field friction through fast reading, simple actions, fewer input errors and reliable information synchronisation.
projects.results_content_crf: The application simplified session tracking and gave trainers a more direct tool for managing attendance day to day.
projects.content_context_gemu: Gemu is a personal project born during my student entrepreneur path, with the goal of creating a mobile social network around esport and video games.
projects.challenges_content_gemu: The project helped me learn Flutter while building a real product: navigation, profiles, interactions, Firebase and progressive codebase organisation.
projects.results_content_gemu: This first version was mainly a learning accelerator, giving me concrete end-to-end experience in mobile product creation.
projects.content_context_myy: My Youkounkoun is a personal application base designed to avoid starting from scratch on every new mobile project.
projects.challenges_content_myy: The objective was to gather reusable bricks while keeping the architecture understandable, adaptable and clean enough to serve as a starting point.
projects.results_content_myy: The project acts as a reusable technical foundation that helps me capitalise on previous experience and speed up new application creation.
projects.content_context_portfolio: This portfolio presents my profile, projects and UI sensitivity through a web experience more personal than a traditional resume.
projects.challenges_content_portfolio: The challenge was balancing visual identity, readability and performance: a distinctive 3D scene, but navigation that stays clear, responsive and maintainable.
projects.results_content_portfolio: The result is a technical and visual showcase reflecting both my interest in immersive interfaces and my intent to keep a clean React foundation.
projects.content_context_bot: This Discord bot is a personal project designed to help a gaming community quickly retrieve useful information from its server.
projects.challenges_content_bot: The work involved organising commands, structuring data and ensuring fast answers while keeping the code easy to evolve across game seasons.
projects.results_content_bot: The bot centralised useful information for server users and let me practise Node.js on a concrete automation use case.
projects.content_context_asm: The project consisted in creating a Flutter season-tracking application for a rugby club, with easy access to key information for supporters.
projects.challenges_content_asm: The main challenges were sports content clarity, regular updates, mobile fluidity and the product ability to evolve throughout the season.
projects.results_content_asm: The application provides a central access point to club information and relies on a stable mobile foundation designed to support supporter engagement.
projects.content_context_pmv: Paris ma Ville aimed to centralise useful Paris events, activities and local information on mobile.
projects.challenges_content_pmv: The product needed to stay readable despite diverse content, with an architecture able to support new features and regularly updated data.
projects.results_content_pmv: The solution makes local information easier to access and provides a scalable Flutter foundation for progressively enriching the user experience.
projects.content_context_bchydro: BC Hydro was a Flutter mobile application project built from scratch for a Canadian electricity company. I worked on it for almost a year as front-end tech lead, in a distributed setup with the front-end handled from France and the backend handled from Canada.
projects.challenges_content_bchydro: The main challenges were setting up a clean Flutter foundation, structuring screens and reusable components, coordinating front-end and backend work across two international teams, and keeping the product stable while building its first mobile foundations.
projects.results_content_bchydro: The project established a clear and maintainable Flutter front-end foundation, supporting the development of an ambitious business mobile application in an international delivery context.
